description: This file defines the NotesListViewModel class, which manages the state and interactions for a list of notes in a SwiftUI application. It handles data binding, CRUD operations, and synchronization with a note repository and sync engine.

classes.name: NotesListViewModel
classes.description: A view model class for managing a list of notes, supporting search, addition, deletion, and synchronization.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Sets up a fetched results observer to monitor notes matching the search text and updates the notes list accordingly.

methods.name: updateQuery
methods.description: Rebinds the observer with the current search query.

methods.name: newNote
methods.description: Creates a new note with empty title and content asynchronously.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note by ID asynchronously and triggers a sync.

methods.name: triggerSync
methods.description: Initiates a synchronization process for notes.
